findings.title: strings.Replacer rebuilt on every mesh render
findings.message: `sweepMesh` runs on every redraw, and each call builds a new `strings.Replacer`. The replacer is immutable and safe for concurrent use, so rebuilding it is wasted allocation. Keeping the bitmap-safe substitution table inline also makes it easy to drift from other places that need the same mapping.
findings.suggestion: Declare the replacer once at package level and reuse it, e.g. `var sweepAxisUnitReplacer = strings.NewReplacer("µ", "u", "°", "deg ")`.

findings.title: Misplaced, misindented thyristor comment
findings.message: The new comment about thyristors is inside the `hbridge` case body, and its two lines have different indentation. A reader can take it as a note on the hbridge loop rather than on the `scr`/`triac` case that follows. The mixed indentation also suggests the file was not run through gofmt.
findings.suggestion: Indent both comment lines at the `case` level, directly above the `case "scr", "triac", ...` line, and run gofmt.
